subject: Post-call: FiscalBank security handshake & artifact plan
messages:
From: Paul Dunn <paul.dunn@fiscalbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@fiscalbank.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — security follow-up

Neha / Rishi — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and asks so we can move this to procurement.

Pain points / objectives we confirmed on the call:
- Audit log access and retention: we need 12 months of immutable audit logs for user/API activity and a plan to export them for our archive.
- Data residency & DPA: FiscalBank needs contract language for data residency controls, plus a DPA template we can share with legal.
- SOC 2 evidence: we expect a concise SOC 2 summary and a list of artifacts (proc, config, sample logs) we can reference during our third-party review.
- Pen test: we want to understand Redwood’s pen-test cadence and whether you can share a redacted report or attacker-surface summary.
- Dedicated vs hosted: depending on SLA and retention guarantees we may prefer a dedicated pool; need rough cost delta and timeline.

As next steps can you: 1) send a one-page SOC2/artifact index, 2) confirm how audit logs can be exported (format, S3 push, encryption), 3) attach your standard DPA (or a template), and 4) estimate lead time for a Dedicated deployment if we choose that option.

We’ll also share our vendor questionnaire and procurement timeline — ideally we aim to complete vendor review within 3 weeks.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Dunn
Head of InfoSec — FiscalBank
paul.dunn@fiscalbank.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Paul Dunn <paul.dunn@fiscalbank.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@fiscalbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 18:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — security follow-up

Paul / Emily — great to meet you. Short recap and commitments from our side so your procurement and security teams have a single place to track things.

Recap (agreed during the call):
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable audit-log retention; default hosted retention is 90 days, but we support customer-configurable archival to S3 for longer retention (12+ months) with object immutability options.
- DPA / Contract: we’ll share a current DPA template and our standard security addendum for data residency language.
- SOC 2 & evidence: we’ll provide a 1-page SOC 2 summary + an artifact index mapping (what we can provide vs what’s internal process docs).
- Pen test: we can provide a redacted executive summary and a cadence note (annual pen test + continuous vulnerability scanning).
- Dedicated timeline & sizing: estimated 4–6 weeks after PO for a single reserved pool (dependent on GPU type); will share a ballpark pricing sheet.

Deliverables we’ll send by EOD Friday (my team):
1) SOC2_Summary_v2.pdf (one page with available artifacts listed) — attached.
2) audit-log-sample.csv (sample export format & fields) — attached.
3) redwood-dpa-template.docx — attached.
4) Dedicated deployment estimate & a short note on security boundaries.

Owners & next calls:
- Neha (me): commercial/contract point — will coordinate procurement and pricing.
- Rishi Malhotra: product-security lead — will be primary on the evidence and pen test follow-up.
- Irene Choi: systems security — will provide technical detail on log exports and retention.

Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up with procurement + security on your side next week to review the DPA and artifact list. Paul — does Tue 20 Apr 9:30am ET or Wed 21 Apr 2pm ET work?

On quoting the attachments: we included sample audit CSV column names and a short mapping to our data model. If you need a specific subset for your vendor questionnaire let us know and we’ll extract it.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the dedicated estimate in a separate email.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Paul Dunn <paul.dunn@fiscalbank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — security follow-up

Paul / Neha — adding technical detail on audit logs, retention, and pen test artifacts.

On Thu, 15 Apr 2026 at 18:05, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Recap (agreed during the call):
> - Retention: Redwood supports configurable audit-log retention; default hosted retention is 90 days, but we support customer-configurable archival to S3 for longer retention (12+ months) with object immutability options.

Details from engineering/security:
- Audit log export: we provide an API-based export and an auto-push to customer-owned S3 buckets (CSV/JSON). Exports are signed and encrypted (AES-256) and can be delivered on a schedule (daily/weekly) or streamed. Attached is audit-log-sample.csv showing typical columns: timestamp, request_id, user_id, action, model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, region.
- Immutability/retention: For hosted customers we can enable S3 Object Lock with governance mode if you need WORM-style immutability; for Dedicated we can additionally lock at the appliance level during the agreed retention window.
- Pen test artifacts: we can share a redacted executive summary and a vulnerabilities matrix (severity, fixed/accepted risk). For detailed findings we require an NDA addendum; redacted versions are usually sufficient for vendor reviews.
- SOC 2 evidence mapping: attached SOC2_Summary_v2.pdf maps out the artifacts we can provide (e.g., access control lists, change management logs, incident response table) and which items are internal-only. We’ll work with your team to extract the subset you need for the review.

Operational notes:
- Dedicated deployments: provisioning includes a hardened network boundary and can incorporate a customer-managed KMS. Lead time estimate is 4–6 weeks as Neha noted; we’ll confirm once we size the pool.
- Data residency: we can pin workloads to region-specific clusters; if you need contractual residency guarantees that will be part of the DPA negotiation.

If FiscalBank has a specific vendor questionnaire, send it over and we’ll produce a mapping table to the SOC2 artifacts and attach excerpts where allowed.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Systems Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Paul Dunn <paul.dunn@fiscalbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@fiscalbank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — security follow-up

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Quick responses:
- The attachments look good; we’ll ingest the sample CSV into our intake form.
- For procurement / DPA: Tue 20 Apr 9:30am ET works for our legal + procurement. Please send calendar invite.
- Pen test: redacted executive summary is sufficient for our initial vendor review; if we need unredacted details later we’ll follow your NDA process.
- Dedicated pool: please include a ballpark monthly price in the estimate email — procurement will want a baseline for budgeting.

We’ll send the vendor questionnaire tonight. Appreciate the clear owners and the artifact index — looking forward to the follow-up.

-Paul
Paul Dunn
Head of InfoSec — FiscalBank
paul.dunn@fiscalbank.com
+1 (617) 555-2198
